description.content:
QA Automation assignment — Part 3 (API Testing).

Folder 1 tests the assignment-specified contract `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (phone_number + otp_code) with 1 positive and 3 negative cases, each with assertions on status code, response body and error messages. `base_url` is an environment variable so the same collection runs against any conforming server or a Postman mock.

Folder 2 is a BONUS: real, live API tests against the actual Enatega backend (GraphQL), which is what the app under test really uses. These requests genuinely execute and assert on real responses.
